en: Rosetta
"Oh, Miria!"{w}
"Hi there, Rosetta. I've brought the adventurer register round for you!"{w}
"Thanks so much! Huh, and who might this be...???"{w}
"A brand-new adventurer. I think they'll be staying with you from today on, so take good care of them."{w}
note: Miria speaks for the newcomer: [JP] = the player will be Rosetta's guest; the request is to Rosetta.

en: "You mean we've got a guest, for the first time in ages!? Wonderful! I'll get a room ready right away!"{w}
"Ahaha, you're getting way ahead of yourself!"{w}
"But I'm just so happy! Oh, that's right! By the way..."{w}
Which room will you be taking?
note: Choice prompt (Rosetta asking the player); [JP]...[JP] shortened from "Which room do you think you will be taking?" to fit ~30 chars.

en: Royal Suite
Suite
Economy
Stables
note: [JP] = the Wizardry-style free 'Stables' lodging.

en: "R-R-Ro... Royal!?{w}You'd like the Royal Suite!?"{w}
"Aaaaahhh...!! Mom, Dad, up in heaven!"{w}{p}"Your Rosetta is finally going to welcome a guest into the Royal Suite!"{w}
note: Rosetta refers to herself by name ([JP]); kept as 'Your Rosetta' since she is addressing her late parents.

en: "I-I'll cook like my life depends on it! Please accept it... my hospitality, with every last ounce of my life...!!"{w}
note: [JP] is a play on [JP] (with all one's might), swapping in [JP] (life); rendered as 'every last ounce of my life'.

en: "Good for you, Rosetta."{w}
"Well then, dear adventurer, until later... Later! I'll be waiting for you...!!"{w}
"The Suite! Certainly! I'll get to use the kitchen for the first time in ages!"{w}
"You can look forward to Rosetta's home cooking! It's seriously delicious!!"{w}
"Okay then, please come back later!"{w}
"Economy! Certainly! Then I'll make up the bed for you, so you can rest off the fatigue of your long journey."{w}
"See you later, then."{w}

note: Rosetta's sulky reply when the player picks the Stables ([JP]).

en: "A-ahaha... Well, try to show her a little consideration once in a while..."{w}
note: Miria to the player, about Rosetta (glossary: female).

en: "And that's the inn taken care of."{w}{p}"Next, just in case the worst happens, I'll show you the temple, where they treat you when you're in bad shape. Though it's best if you never need it..."{w}
Saines
"Hello, Miria. I am glad to see you looking so well."{w}
"This is Bishop Saines of the Temple of Orses. You'll probably be relying on him whenever you get poisoned, paralyzed or turned to stone."{w}
note: [JP] = Bishop (the source's title here); glossary position says priest ([JP], from Wikipedia). 'him' per glossary gender (male).

en: "Orses is merciful. I am sure Orses will be a source of strength to you all."{w}
note: Orses' gender is unknown: name repeated instead of a pronoun; [JP] not rendered as 'Lord' (glossary rule for gods).

en: "I'm back."{w}
note: Unseen speaker (???), revealed as Sigret next row.

en: Sigret
"Almite and party, the paralyzed and petrified ones -- retrieval complete. They're resting next door, so please see to them later."{w}
note: New name [JP] romanized 'Almite'. Addressed to Saines.

en: "Very well. Thank you."{w}
"Sigret!"{w}
"Oh, hello, Miria.{w}Your adventurers got themselves wiped out again, you know?"{w}
note: [JP] = the adventurers registered at Miria's Training Hall.

en: "S-sorry for all the trouble."{w}
"Trouble? Not at all. That's my job.{w}I specialize in retrieval and laying spirits to rest. Even if they come back to haunt the place, I'll see them on their way properly."{w}
note: [JP] = laying spirits to rest; [JP] = guiding the dead onward.

en: "You there, too -- go ahead and get wiped out without a worry."{w}
note: Sigret to the player ([JP]). Deadpan dark humour kept at full strength.

en: "Now, Sigret. You mustn't say such reckless things."{w}
"If you get wiped out in a dungeon, either your friends form a new party and go retrieve you, or you ask the temple to retrieve you."{w}
note: [JP] has no stated subject; 'you' = the player managing the roster.

en: "Sigret is one of those retrievers.{w}
note: Opening fragment of the next row (no closing quote in the source either); keep its wording identical to the first line of SCDWMAP:2859.

en:
{0E}"Sigret is one of those retrievers.{0F}
...Try not to need her services too often, okay~"{w}
note: First line repeats SCDWMAP:2857 between {0E}/{0F}; the \n after {0F} is kept so the repeat stays on its own line. 'her' = Sigret (glossary: female).

en: "Oh, there's no need to hold back."{w}
note: Sigret answers Miria's 'try not to need her': don't be shy about using me.

en: "Every time a retrieval request comes in, my mind can't help but wander... Ah, I wonder how this next adventurer met their end?"{w}
"Huh?"{w}
"How much of the body is left? Are they splattered all over the place? Or have they rotted just right and become supper for all our friends in the forest..."{w}
note: Gore kept at full strength ([JP], [JP]).

en: "Eek! Stop iiit!!"{w}
"Sigret! That is quite enough!"{w}
"Hee hee. Well then, until we meet again."{w}

"Sigret has an extraordinarily strong interest in the nature of life."{w}{p}"She may talk like that, but the reason she took up the retrieval work she does now"{w}{p}"is her own way of caring: 'so that wiped-out adventurers are not just left where they fell, to become souls of the in-between.'"{w}{p}"She is honest at heart, so please be good friends with her."{w}
note: One sentence is cut across pages 2-3 in the source; English is cut at the matching point. [JP] = glossary 'souls of the in-between'. [JP] confirms Sigret is female.

en: "Oh, please, we're the ones who should be saying that!"{w}
note: [JP]: answering Saines' request to befriend Sigret.

en: "Riiight, so is that the whole tour?"{w}{p}"I'm heading back to the Training Hall, so come and register whenever it suits you. See ya!"{w}

"Welcome! I've been waiting for you!{w}...See, I wanted to thank you for the Silent Shell."{w}{p}"So I thought I'd let you, and only you, form parties even with people whose personalities are worlds apart!"{w}{p}"I used to let everyone team up however they liked, but once a huge brawl broke out between Good and Evil folks.{w}It got so bad the Magic Bureau sent someone to check on things."{w}{p}"So now I've made it off-limits, as a rule of my own.{w}But you lot look like you'll be fine, so I'll make a special exception for you."{w}
note: Berte, after the Silent Shell quest (99111). [JP] = 'personality' as in the pilot row 2675; [JP]/[JP] = Good/Evil alignments. Source typo [JP] read as [JP].

en: {0E}      *  Mixed Good & Evil Parties Unlocked  *{0F}{w}
note: System banner. Source centres it with full-width spaces; 6 leading spaces is a rough centring guess for a ~55-char line -- check in game.

en: "Don't tell anyone else, okay!"{w}
"Welcome iiin!"{w}

"...Oh?{w}I don't recognize that face. Nice to meet you!"{w}{p}"I'm Berte, I run this tavern. I was an adventurer myself once, so for old times' sake I run it as a place where adventurers can meet. Glad to have you!"{w}
note: [JP] = a tavern where adventurers meet and form parties; [JP] = for old times' sake (her adventurer past).

en: "Here you go! Have some fresh milk, to celebrate getting to know you. The first glass is on the house. Don't be shy, drink up!"{w}
"Is your adventure going well? If you get tired of pushing on, come and rest here anytime.{w}For a price, of course~"{w}
note: The music-note symbol is not ASCII; rendered as '~' here and in later Berte rows.

en: "You know what a tavern keeper's favorite thing is? Watching the rookies split up the very first treasure they've found!"{w}
"When I see them all chummy and having the best time!{w}It just makes me want to... pat them on the head and tell them what good kids they are."{w}
"A word of warning: even if you get your hands on some rare treasure, you'd better not think about keeping it all to yourself, hm?{w}...It's been known to end in bloodshed."{w}
note: [JP] = a fight with blades; 'end in bloodshed'.

en: "Well, attack spells don't work in this tavern, and anyone who draws a sword, whatever the reason, gets a taste of Berte's iron fist~"{w}
note: Berte refers to herself as [JP] (third person); kept as 'Berte's'.

en: "Watching all of you from across the counter, I can't help feeling nostalgic."{w}{p}"Some people drink like fish and party up a storm every time they come in,{w}and some quietly enjoy their time with their companions."{w}{p}"The ones who don't like crowds pick at my cooking at the counter, or listen to the bard's songs."{w}{p}"I can't be on your side of the counter anymore, can I?{w}I wonder how everyone's doing..."{w}
note: [JP] in the last line = Berte's old adventuring companions (inferred from the nostalgia). '...side of the counter' makes the counter image explicit ([JP]).

en: "Oh, shoot...{w}What do I do? Hmmm..."{w}
note: Berte alone, over the broken Silent Shell (see 2918/2920).

en: "Oh, welcome. I'll be right with you, so grab a seat somewhere and wait."{w}{p}"Maybe it'll stick back together...{w}Nope, no good...{w}...Hm? Wait a minute? ...Oh, I've got it!!"{w}
note: Page 2 is Berte muttering to herself about the broken shell.

en: "Hey, you guuuys~"{w}
Free? You're free, right~?
note: Yes/No prompt: yes -> 2914, no -> 2916.

en: "...Come on, you should say you're busy, even if it's a lie.{w}Oh well. If you're free, that's perfect!"{w}
"Aww. Come on, please!{w}Lend an ear to poor Berte's troubles!"{w}
note: Self-reference [JP] again; 'poor' carries the wheedling tone.

en: "Take a look at this broken shell.{w}This is called a Silent Shell."{w}{p}"It's a rare shellfish that only grows in mountain water, and it has the power to suppress magic spreading through the air and sound carrying."{w}{p}"Use it on someone, and they can't utter a spell, or even a word."{w}{p}"Ordinary people can only tell that it soaks up sound, so that's why they call it a Silent Shell."{w}{p}"I keep one on hand at the tavern for when powerful magic users, like Mages, get drunk, but..."{w}
note: [JP] = the Mage class (glossary); [JP] = 'magic user' (glossary).

en: "I kicked it a little while ago and broke it!{w}Ahahahahaha!!"{w}
"I don't even have to say it, right?{w}...Please, don't make that face! Of course I'm not asking you to do it for free!"{w}
note: Source ends [JP] (rhetorical); simplified to '!'.

en: "I'll treat you to some milk! Fresh from the cow!{w}Here! Drink uuup!!"{w}
You were made to drink it.{w}
note: Narration; subject is the player/party ('you').

en: "There we go, you've taken your payment, so you can't say no now~ Ufufu."{w}{p}"The Silent Beast in the forest at Moonlight Falls collects Silent Shells, so could you ask it nicely and get one for me?"{w}{p}"Really, I ought to go myself, but... that thing seems to hate me.{w}No matter how many times I go and ask, it won't give me one."{w}{p}"I tried inviting it to drinking parties to make friends, and entertaining it with songs and dances, but...{w}far from making friends, it attacks me!?"{w}{p}"I'm sure you'll be fine!{w}Sorry to ask, but I'm counting on you!"{w}
note: New name [JP] = 'Silent Beast'. Treated as a single creature ([JP]); 'it' since it is a beast. Moonlight Falls per glossary.

en: "Oh, welcome!{w}I'll come take your order in a bit, so grab a seat and wait!!"{w}
"Huh, that thing you've got there... isn't that a Silent Shell!?"{w}
Hand over the Silent Shell?
